prompt: I’m going on a weekend trip to Germany and have limited space in my luggage. I’m choosing between taking with me either an umbrella or a waterproof jacket. Which one will me more useful to take with me?
response: In Germany, it's often better to have an umbrella than a waterproof jacket because umbrellas are more space-efficient and can be used as a walking stick in addition to keeping you dry. They allow for better visibility in rain and are lighter to carry.
